title: CertB-pushed affine local moment and formal cubic-theta limit hierarchy (10935831/12500000 = 0.87486648)
description: Tightens the reserve-balanced affine local-moment defect from g = 1/250 = 400/100000 to g = 429/100000 by utilizing the available slack in the extracted-error B026/B025 budget (leaving 19/15000000 > 0 on Face 2) and tightening final analytic/endpoint reserves to 1/50000000. Regenerates the dyadic Bernstein enclosure certificates in B028, B030, B038, and B116 at h = 397/500, ell = 1567507/9375000, ly = 4308736/9375000, and kappa = 4685831/6250000, yielding theta = 10935831/12500000 = 0.87486648. Also adds B127.lean proving the formal multi-regime hard-limit hierarchy across the cubic-theta strip architecture (fixed-plane single-cell wall 10935831/12500000, B026 four-face ceiling g <= 36/8375, variable-slope pivot domination, truncated-sieve no-go, multi-regime base-contract closure walls down to 0.874835, Regime V interior coupled variable-slope physical envelope down to 328/375 = 0.87466667, and the universal 13/15 low-side LP floor). Builds on Kari Roegnvaldsson's reserve-local-20261013 and affine-local-20261013, nielstron's local44-20261013, Zhongpai Gao's local-moment work, Hailey Collet's Cycle25 framework, Akash Levy's weighted numerator, and OpenAI/math.
